notes: Overview: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building an in-app assistant and semantic search across product docs and release notes.
Trial summary: Hosted API trial ran 30 days (2% traffic shadowing + synthetic load). Team wants to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost control after validating quality.
Observed metrics (hosted trial): avg QPS ~12, 95th pct QPS ~34, average concurrency observed ~7, observed peak concurrency ~22 (during morning release window).

Token mix observed: chat/conversation ~72% of requests (avg prompt ~120 tokens, avg response ~420 tokens -> ~540 tokens/request), embeddings ~18% (batching used for search indexing, avg input ~512 tokens), semantic-reranking ~10% (avg ~200 tokens).

Weighted average tokens/request (trial): ~500 tokens/request -> translates to ~12 QPS * 500 tokens = ~6k tokens/sec steady. Rough monthly steady-state ~15.6B tokens/month (30d). Peak-month (growth + campaigns) estimate x3 -> ~46B tokens/month.

Performance targets: p95 latency target for chat interactions <= 400ms (user-facing), background embedding/indexing can be relaxed to 2s. Current hosted trial p95 ~450-600ms; optimizing batching/cache could bring into target.

Dedicated ask: Meadowridge wants a reserved pool that covers steady-state with headroom for p95 peaks and a burst path for major releases. Will consider 12–24 month commit for discount if sizing looks accurate.
Quote from VP Product: 'We need predictable unit economics before we commit — peak spikes are the killer for our margins.'
Security notes: SOC2 evidence required, SSO via SAML mandatory, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS for encryption of customer data. Data residency: US-only for now.
dedicated_capacity_recommendation: Baseline reserved pool: 2 x 8-GPU serving nodes (sized for their chosen open model and 1k token context) to cover steady-state 12 QPS with 2x headroom for caching and batching optimizations. Autoscale policy: allow burst to 4 nodes for 95th percentile events (covers observed 95th QPS ~34). Expected burst concurrency headroom to support peak concurrency ~22. Include KV/prefix cache and batching settings to reduce per-token cost by ~20% — run 2-week tuning window during onboarding.
traffic_forecast_summary: 30-day hosted trial baseline -> steady tokens ~15.6B/month. Forecast scenarios: conservative (1.5x growth) -> ~23.4B/mo; expected (3x) -> ~46.8B/mo; aggressive promotional quarter (5x) -> ~78B/mo. Use these bands for commit tiers. Recommend committed tier that covers conservative->expected with burst billing for >expected.
pricing_and_contract_notes: AE discussed draft pricing: commit discount tier options (6mo/12mo), expected ARR band $60k-$180k depending on commit. Meadowridge prefers SKU-style reserved pool + overage at lower token rate. Legal wants IPR clause clarified for retention of logs and model telemetry.
